# Any TDF for VS Code

[简体中文](https://github.com/any-tdf/any-tdf/blob/main/extensions/vscode-extension/README_CN.md)

Hover documentation and framework-native code completion for STDF, RTDF, and VTDF components.

## Installation

Search for `Any TDF for VS Code` in the VS Code Extensions view, open the [Marketplace page](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=STDF.stdf-vscode-extension), or install it from the command line:

```sh
code --install-extension STDF.stdf-vscode-extension
```

## Features

- Detects the nearest `package.json` and enables the matching library only when it declares `stdf`, `rtdf`, or `vtdf`.
- Shows bundled component API documentation, the installed and latest package versions, and direct demo, guide, version, and source links on hover.
- Completes component props, events, child content, snippets, and Vue slots with framework-native syntax.
- Supports Simplified Chinese and English API documentation through the `AnyTDF.English` setting.
- Covers public child components as well as top-level components exported by each library.

## Framework support

| Library | Package | Files          | Completion syntax                                 |
| ------- | ------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| STDF    | `stdf`  | `.svelte`      | Svelte props, events, snippets, and child content |
| RTDF    | `rtdf`  | `.jsx`, `.tsx` | React props, events, and child content            |
| VTDF    | `vtdf`  | `.vue`         | Vue props, events, and slots                      |

Language services remain external to this project. The extension pack includes [Svelte for VS Code](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=svelte.svelte-vscode) and [Vue - Official](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=Vue.volar). RTDF uses the JavaScript and TypeScript language support built into VS Code.

## Usage

Open a supported file inside a package that depends on `stdf`, `rtdf`, or `vtdf`. Hover over a component name to read its API details, or type inside a component start tag to receive completions generated from that component's bundled API documentation.

## Configuration

Bundled API documentation uses Simplified Chinese by default. Search for `AnyTDF.English` in VS Code Settings, or add the following entry to `settings.json`, to use English:

```json
{
	"AnyTDF.English": true
}
```

The legacy `STDF.English` setting remains readable for users upgrading from STDF for VS Code. `AnyTDF.English` takes precedence when both settings are explicitly configured.

## Upgrade from STDF for VS Code

Any TDF for VS Code retains the Marketplace identifier [`STDF.stdf-vscode-extension`](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=STDF.stdf-vscode-extension), so existing users receive unified STDF, RTDF, and VTDF support through a normal extension update.

## Privacy

The extension does not collect telemetry. It reads the nearest workspace `package.json` to detect the active TDF package and requests public npm Registry metadata to display the latest package version.
